aura: White-heron divine arrival c03/c07 fills frame in reverent action; no unsupported forge magic or aura.

prompt:
ONE original square premium painterly cinematic Mitoloka illustration of Kanayago Kami, the revered Japanese smithing goddess arriving in Izumo on a white heron.
ANATOMY: ONE adult FEMALE deity with ONE head, TWO natural eyes, TWO arms and TWO legs fully covered by opaque layered dark indigo and antique-ivory Japanese ROBES. Plain tied dark hair, no crown or invented weapon. She rides ONE large WHITE HERON with ONE long beaked head, TWO eyes, TWO feathered wings, TWO long bird legs and one short tail [kanayago-kami-c01,kanayago-kami-c03].
MOMENT: Descend toward viewer on the heron as it lands on a thick katsura tree bough, wings driving upward and talons grasping bark; goddess leans forward with one hand steady on bird's shoulder and other hand open in a solemn downward greeting. Her face commanding and clearly visible above white bird neck.
POWER: documented arrival riding a white heron and alighting on katsura, physically whipping robes and tree leaves; no invented metal magic, flames, beams or aura [kanayago-kami-c07].
SCALE & CAMERA: extreme low close angle from beneath branch; goddess face/upper body and heron's huge white wing sweep dominate square; no ordinary distant rider scene.
LIGHT & WEATHER: one golden dawn shaft behind tree rims feathers, robe folds and dignified face, deep walnut mountain shadows, ordinary leaf spray.
SURFACE: layered damp white feathers, coarse opaque robe folds, rough katsura bark, small green heart-shaped leaves.
SETTING: mountain katsura tree in Izumo, Japanese wooded slopes secondary [kanayago-kami-c03,kanayago-kami-c07].
MOOD: reverential awe at active sacred arrival, dignified divine authority, never monster, cute, ordinary woman or decorative portrait.
HARD CONSTRAINTS: no text, lettering, inscriptions, logo, border, frame or watermark; no extra heads, limbs or fingers; no design borrowed from any film, game, anime or comic; no nudity or explicit gore; no generic glow aura, neon outline or energy ribbons. Premium painterly brushwork, dark warm walnut and antique gold palette, square composition.
